summary: Unfold ν_S through the chart: the right side is ∫_y ∫_{u ∈ 𝖴} ∫_{h ∈ U(κ)} f(x·embedH(h)·u·y); integrate u and y together over G₁ (unfolding along 𝖴), swap with h, and use left invariance of Haar measure and the total mass 1 of U(κ).

steps.claim: By definition of ν_S as an image measure of besselHaar(𝔰) × dh, the inner integral is ∫_{u ∈ 𝖴} ∫_{h ∈ U(κ)} f(x·(embedH(h)·u·y)) dh d besselHaar(𝔰)(u).

steps.lean:
erw [lintegral_orbitMeasure_lintegral (f := fun g ↦ ∫⁻ k, f (x * (embedH k * g))),
    lintegral_lintegral_swap] <;> simp [← mul_assoc, lintegral_mul_left_eq_self] <;> fun_prop
steps.claim: Integrating y over 𝖴∖G₁ against the 𝖴-integral gives ∫_{G₁} F(g) dg with F(g) = ∫_h f(x·embedH(h)·g) dh (lintegral_orbitMeasure_lintegral); swap the integrals over g and h (Tonelli); by left invariance ∫_g f(x·embedH(h)·g) dg = ∫ f for each h, and the measure on U(κ) has total mass 1.
